run_perturb_systems_main: run the main function to rattle relaxation pathway images at 5 variances and generate VASP input directories
create_vasp_poscar_from_trajectory: create VASP POSCAR files by reading ASE trajectory images and writing rattled structures in vasp format
rattle_atomic_images_at_variances: rattle atomic structure images along a relaxation pathway at 5 different standard deviation variances
generate_slurm_submission_scripts: generate SLURM job submission scripts with unique job names, output, and error file paths per perturbed structure
copy_vasp_input_files: copy KPOINTS and POTCAR input files into perturbed structure directories alongside generated POSCAR files
